scope: Proposition 11.11 (Isolated-type commutation) of the manuscript “Arithmeticity of twisted finite correspondences for lattices over local fields” (preprints/Arithmeticity-of-twisted-finite-correspondences-for-lattices-over-local-fields-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1d070a5c4cd8496), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 147. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each isolated type, all angle-height measurements Qz strongly commute as z ranges over its source boundary. Their common law is the evaluation law of the smooth cone isometries in Lemma 11.8; in particular its angular maps are nonsingular smooth bijections. The two normal copies sharing the trunk slot commute with each other at every pair of labels. All these measurements retain the source and measured-group covariances, base decomposability, and complementary-group commutation of the original angle and height measurements.
